_description: Faction definitions for Phase 3. Defines groups, territories, leaders, hostility levels, and allied monsters.
_note: 6 factions matching Phase 3 design. IDs used across npcs.json (faction references) and quests.json (faction prerequisites).

factions.name: Forest Villagers
factions.description: A peaceful community of forest-dwelling villagers who trade herbs, food, and crafted goods.

factions.name: Goblin Tribes
factions.description: Aggressive goblin warriors who raid forest settlements. Can be negotiated with for non-aggression pacts.

factions.name: Coastal Merchants
factions.description: A loose alliance of coastal traders who control sea routes and salt production.

factions.name: Desert Djinn Clan
factions.description: Mystical desert dwellers who control rare mineral trade routes. Powerful but isolationist.

factions.name: Swamp Tribes
factions.description: Dangerous swamp-dwelling tribes skilled in poison and stealth. Rarely trust outsiders.

factions.name: Mountain Clans
factions.description: Stoic mountain dwellers who mine rare ores and craft masterwork weapons. Respectful of strength.
